title: Survival Petrified Oak Slab
description: Adds a petrified oak slab to survival
body:
## About
The [Petrified oak slab](https://minecraft.fandom.com/wiki/Petrified_Oak_Slab) is a vanilla item that is not used in survival, it can only be obtained with cheats. This mod adds several crafting recipes for these slabs and changes the texture so that they can be distinguished from ordinary oak slabs
